notes: Systematic audit of every field read off system objects across all deliverables, following the accountId bug in 5.6.16, to check for other silently-dropped or non-existent fields. Found two more real, always-wrong values. (1) isEOA/isEOS/hardwareAgeMonths/eoaDate/eosDate/maintenanceCostEst are not real fields anywhere in the harvest -- the Tech Refresh Roadmap (TAM Success Plan + QBR Pack) always showed 'No immediate tech refresh candidates identified' and 'Avg Age: 0 years' for every platform regardless of actual fleet age or EOS exposure. Switched to lifecycle.isNearEos/eoaDate/eosDate (the real fields used correctly in 10+ other places) and originalShipDate for age. (2) firmwareStatus is not a real field either -- OS Currency in the Security Posture Brief always read 0/N, which meant the new data-driven Security Actions list (5.6.14) would falsely claim every system needed a firmware update even on a fully current fleet. Switched to the swRecMin/osVersion + versionLt() check used correctly everywhere else. Both verified live: an EOS system now correctly surfaces with real dates instead of being silently excluded; two fully current systems now correctly read 2/2 instead of 0/2 with no false firmware-update action.
